items.title: Sanofi gains after expanding Regeneron partnership with $8 billion deal
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Sanofi jumped as much as 3.6% on Thursday before paring gains to trade 1.1% higher after the French drugmaker agreed to pay Regeneron $1 billion upfront and up to $7 billion in additional payments to expand their partnership on four long-acting medicines for inflammatory diseases.
